description.en: Simulate Codex tool system full dispatch: FunctionCall → build_tool_call() payload parse → ToolCallRuntime tokio::spawn → RwLock parallel control → ToolRegistry handler lookup → ShellHandler execute → result return.

steps.content:
ToolRegistry::dispatch_any(invocation)
// registry.rs:237
① handler(&tool_name) → ShellHandler  // O(1) HashMap 查找
② handler.matches_kind(&payload)      // 校验 payload 类型匹配
③ pre_tool_use_payload → run_pre_tool_use_hooks()  // PreToolUse hook
④ if is_mutating: tool_call_gate.wait_ready()       // 等待工具门控放行
⑤ handler.handle_any(invocation).await              // 实际执行
⑥ run_post_tool_use_hooks()                         // PostToolUse hook

annotation.zh: registry.rs:237 — dispatch_any 完整流程：查找→类型校验→PreHook→门控等待→执行→PostHook
annotation.en: registry.rs:237 — dispatch_any full flow: lookup → type check → PreHook → gate wait → execute → PostHook

annotation.en: handlers/shell.rs — After parsing params, enters three-phase orchestration: approval → sandbox → execute
